tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects (websites) this API key can access, with their ids.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: Feedback reports, newest first. By default the open ones across every project the key allows.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: One report in full: a Markdown brief for fixing it (URL, selected text, comment, viewport, browser), the raw fields, and the screenshot as an image.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Set the status of a report (resolved after fixing it, rejected when nothing should be done, open to reopen) and/or the important flag.
